evidence: Within one click, the About page explicitly identifies the practice as artistic, civic, technical, and social; within the second click, linked project pages make those continuities inspectable.

The About page traces more than three coherent continuities: Open House into WOW List, Sunday Dinner and 196, NYC Artist Coalition and FairRentNYC, and source-backed team memory. It shows observed relationships becoming models, interfaces used with people, learning records, and durable continuation.
Sunday Dinner and 196 treats hospitality, trust, onboarding, access handoffs, minimal documentation, and follow-up as participation infrastructure while withholding participant-level data.

WOW List connects community vocabulary and organizer attention to a collaboratively editable natural-language platform, followable keyword communities, publishing workflows, historical instrumentation, and long-term stewardship. Its current surface is accurately labeled as a noindex return threshold rather than a restored calendar.

FairRentNYC connects lived participation, facilitated rooms, public action surfaces, policy translation, source maps, running minutes, action trackers, and campaign memory while repeatedly distinguishing Jamie's implementation from collective policy outcomes.
CallNYC shows civic data becoming recognizable resident issue pathways and clearly labels the product an archived, unofficial, non-current prototype.

The home and Technical Operations pages immediately establish the target role: Technical Project Manager — Product Operations & Implementation, with requirements, delivery rhythms, risk signals, documentation, launch support, onboarding, and handoffs translated into concrete project evidence.
Citation anchors expose source notes, evidentiary limits, and return paths. Eight representative reachable public sources resolved successfully during review.

Dates and statuses remain differentiated and visible: HJE 2009–2015; CallNYC 2016 and archived; FairRentNYC 2017–Present; WOW List historical activity separated from its 2026 return-in-progress threshold; Sunday Dinner and 196 marked 2010s–present and summary-only.
safety_findings: Collective credit is explicit at the appropriate scope.
The portfolio repeatedly rejects sole-causation readings of coalition and policy outcomes.
Participant-level community records and protected educational records remain excluded.
Source notes distinguish evidence from endorsement, attendance, causality, and outcome claims.
recommendation: PASS. The candidate satisfies PR-015 at the full 4/4 threshold. From this lens, no additional revision or Jamie review is required before release.
